questions.nlq: Could you tell me which products are popular and how many times each has been ordered?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: Popular means products that have been ordered more than 50 times.
meanings.gt_sql: SELECT "Products"."product_name", COUNT(*) AS "order_count" FROM "Products" JOIN "Actual_Order_Products" ON "Products"."product_id" = "Actual_Order_Products"."product_id" GROUP BY "Products"."product_id" HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 ORDER BY "order_count" DESC;

meanings.hidden_knowledge: Popular means products that rank in the top 10% by order count.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH product_counts AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        COALESCE(r.cnt, 0) + COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) AS order_count
    FROM Products p
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM Regular_Order_Products
        GROUP BY product_id
    ) r ON p.product_id = r.product_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM Actual_Order_Products
        GROUP BY product_id
    ) a ON p.product_id = a.product_id
)
SELECT
    product_name,
    order_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        product_name,
        order_count,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS rnk,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
    FROM product_counts
)
WHERE rnk <= CEIL(total * 0.1);
}
